mechanical_return_cleanup.scope: Return a final plain int call result directly instead of assigning it to a private nonvolatile result temporary and immediately returning it. The expression, arguments and every earlier statement stay in order. Remove only a now-unused plain int result declaration. The candidate must end at the function boundary, have brace depth one and follow a completed statement/block. Nested/unbraced conditional return and escaped-address controls are rejected. No result address or inline assembly occurs in the definition. This is a mechanically checked source simplification, not a new native-body review or binary equivalence proof.
